text:
maria: Heads up — CobaltPay on dedicated tier requested batching config tweaks. They need p95 <120ms for gen (seq<=512) but are on a tight GPU budget. Profiler shows tail spikes when batch formation >6 and when KV cache miss rate climbs. Can we propose token_budget and queue limits?

kevin: digging in. Quick summary from the perf sampler: when batch_size goes from 6->8 on their A100 pool the kernel selector falls back to generic matmul (lossy for fused attention path). Observed numbers:```
batch_size: 8 -> p95 210ms
batch_size: 6 -> p95 115ms
kv_miss_rate: 0.28
kernel_switch_count: 47
```
kv memcpy overhead shows up as extra 20-40ms on the hot path.

jules: my initial proposal (aiming to keep latency SLO and reasonable throughput):
```
{"token_budget_per_cycle": "3072", "max_queue_wait_ms": "25", "max_batch_size": "6", "max_inflight_batches": "3", "kv_prefetch": "on", "kernel_hint": "prefer_fused"}
```
- token_budget_per_cycle 3072 is tuned for seq<=512 and their QPS.
- cap max_batch_size at 6 to avoid falling into the slow kernel.
- short queue wait (25ms) keeps tail latency down but allows small batching.
- kv_prefetch reduces memcpy stalls on misses (trades a bit of memory for latency).

maria: +1 to jules' config. For Dedicated we should expose this as a per-customer queue policy so we can A/B test without cluster-wide changes. Also request CobaltPay's billing owner signed off on slightly higher token unit charge if we increase prefetch memory usage. :eyes:

ops-oncall: we'll run a canary in their dedicated pool. Canary plan: apply above flags as a config patch for pool "cobalt-ded-1", 10% traffic, 2-hour ramp, collect p50/p95/alloc. Command for the operator template:```
--pool=cobalt-ded-1 --batching.token_budget=3072 --batching.max_batch_size=6 --queue.max_wait_ms=25 --kv.prefetch=1 --kernel.selector=prefer_fused
```
Schedule: tomorrow 09:00 PT. I'll add the canary job to the runbook and include rollback markers. :shipit:

perf-bot: regression alert (yesterday 22:18 UTC): recent kernel-selector change increased p95 by +12% for CobaltPay across the fleet. Suggested mitigation: pin kernel selector to prefer_fused for models with head_size divisibility of 32 until we can add a targeted fused matmul for the edge cases.

kevin: good catch. I'll coordinate the canary and a quick kernel-pin rollback if canary shows improvement. If the canary passes, ops — please apply the per-customer queue_policy; otherwise roll back the selector change and we'll iterate on a better kernel-match heuristic. Will post profiling dump after first canary run.

maria: thanks team — once we have canary metrics, we'll send config proposal to CobaltPay and SC for sign-off.

(ops-oncall added note: created ticket RN-4122 for follow-up: "investigate fused kernel misses for head_size=48")
